companyUrls.description: LinkedIn company page URLs or slugs. Accepts: https://www.linkedin.com/company/microsoft/, https://www.linkedin.com/company/microsoft/about/, or just the slug: microsoft
companyUrls.title: Company URLs

connectionDegree.description: Filter by LinkedIn connection degree: F = 1st, S = 2nd, O = 3rd+
connectionDegree.title: Connection Degree

cookie.description: Your LinkedIn session cookie. Accepts: (1) the li_at value from browser DevTools, or (2) full cookies JSON array from an extension like EditThisCookie.
cookie.title: LinkedIn Cookie

currentCompany.description: When true, restrict results to people currently working at the company. When false, include past employees as well.
currentCompany.title: Restrict to Current Employees

function.description: Filter employees by job function (e.g., Engineering, Sales).
function.title: Job Function

keywords.description: Optional keyword to narrow results (e.g., 'Software Engineer', 'VP Sales'). Leave blank to return all visible employees.
keywords.title: Keyword Filter

maxEmployees.description: Maximum number of employee profiles to scrape per company. LinkedIn typically surfaces 200-1000 employees for large companies.
maxEmployees.title: Max Employees Per Company

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional Apify proxy configuration. Residential proxy recommended for best results.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
